scope: Local OEM runtime inputs; touch files remain preparation assets, not automatic installation
sensor_list_policy: Preserve the OEM list verbatim; only the exact reviewed missing-file set is accepted during staging. DSP tolerance is not established by a host check.
touch_policy: Both panel variants are preparation assets. Existing runtime admits pinned CSOT only; require panel identity and a qualified private reference before using the existing local-touch-data recipe.
bluetooth_policy: Retain all OEM board variants for kernel selection; never package the factory address or infer board identity from filenames.
